post.originalText:
I paid $12.84 for one prompt. GPT did it for $5.38.

Same prompt, one shot each: a 3D Three.js film of the Colosseum rising from Nero's drained lake in AD 70 to Titus' opening games in AD 80. Foundations, three arcaded tiers, the attic, the velarium, then dusk.

Claude Opus 5.5: $12.84
GPT: $5.38

Same page design on both, so you're judging only the 3D films.

Top is Claude, bottom is GPT. Which one would you pay for?
